scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && node scripts/check-lint-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-color-wall.mjs && node scripts/check-case-collisions.mjs && node scripts/check-sleep-wall.mjs
scripts.test:int:if-db:
if pg_isready -q -h localhost -p ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433} 2>/dev/null; then pnpm test:int; else printf '
================================================================
  SKIPPED: integration tests did NOT run.
  No Postgres on localhost:%s — start it with `docker compose up -d`.
  CI runs them. A green `pnpm check` here is NOT a green CI.
================================================================

' "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433}"; fi
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:int:if-db
